aaer.label: Adopt-Adapt-Expand-Respond
aaer.description: Tracks how market actors respond to an intervention by adopting new practices, adapting them, expanding reach, or responding to system-level shifts.
aaer.useCase: Best for market systems development (MSD) programmes tracking crowding-in and private sector behaviour change.

msr.label: Market Systems Resilience
msr.description: Assesses the capacity of market systems to absorb shocks, adapt, and transform — going beyond outputs to understand durability of change.
msr.useCase: Best for programmes in fragile or crisis-affected contexts where long-term system durability matters.

oh.label: Outcome Harvesting
oh.description: Works backwards from observed outcomes — collecting evidence of what actually changed and how the intervention contributed.
oh.useCase: Best for complex, emergent programmes where linear attribution is difficult and stakeholder-driven evidence matters.

msc.label: Most Significant Change
msc.description: A participatory technique that collects stories of significant change from stakeholders, which panels then review to select the 'most significant'.
msc.useCase: Best for capturing unexpected or qualitative changes, elevating beneficiary voices, and communicating impact.
